info.title: Wizzx AI API
info.description: Wizzx asynchronous image, video, and audio generation API. Model keys are placed in the submit URL. Submit returns a Wizzx task_id; poll that ID through /api/v1/task/status. Authentication uses a Wizzx API key in the Authorization: Bearer <key> header.

post.description: Creates one asynchronous paid task. Save data.task_id and poll the status endpoint. Do not automatically retry an ambiguous submit.

422.description: Field not accepted by the action, mode or range violation, or unusable source task

bearerAuth.description: Wizzx API key. This is not a JWT.

Veo3SubmitRequest.description: text-to-video must omit image_urls; image-to-video requires 1-2 images; reference-to-video requires 1-3 images and duration 8. veo3_quality supports 6 or 8 seconds and does not support reference-to-video. model and resolution select a fixed per-video price; duration does not change it.

model.description: veo3_fast (default), veo3_lite (lowest cost), or veo3_quality (highest fidelity; 6 or 8 seconds, no reference-to-video).

SeedanceSubmitRequest.description: Current HTTP contract: omit resolution for the 480p default. Explicit 480p is temporarily rejected by the shared gateway binding; explicit values may be 720p or 1080p. image-to-video requires exactly one image.

resolution.description: Omit this field to use the current 480p default. Explicit 480p is not accepted until the gateway binding is fixed.

Seedance15ProSubmitRequest.description: Current HTTP contract: duration is 4-12 seconds and explicit resolution is 720p. The model intends to support duration=-1 and 480p, but shared gateway binding currently rejects both. image-to-video requires 1-2 images.

task_id.description: Wizzx task ID returned by submit.

KlingSubmitRequest.description: image-to-video requires exactly one image_urls item; text-to-video must omit image_urls. image_tail, masks, and camera_control are mutually exclusive for image-to-video. aspect_ratio and sound are only valid for kling-v2-6.

prompt.description: Required prompt. The gateway enforces a 2500-byte UTF-8 limit.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt. The gateway enforces a 2500-byte UTF-8 limit.

cfg_scale.description: V1.x only. Explicit 0 is currently normalized to 0.5; omit for V2.x.

aspect_ratio.description: kling-v2-6 only; defaults to 16:9 for that model.

x.description: The backend currently rejects zero because of binding semantics, despite the intended non-negative range.

y.description: The backend currently rejects zero because of binding semantics, despite the intended non-negative range.

CameraControlConfig.description: Exactly one property must be non-zero.

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation.
prompt.example: A beautiful sunset over the ocean with vibrant colors

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the image between 21:9 and 9:21. Format: width:height (e.g., '16:9', '1:1', '9:16'). Common ratios: 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, 21:9, 9:21.

image_urls.description: Array of reference image URLs (max 4). JPEG/PNG/WebP, up to 30MB each. Replaces deprecated input_image fields.

output_format.description: Output format for the generated image.

prompt_upsampling.description: Whether to perform upsampling on the prompt. If active, automatically modifies the prompt for more creative generation.

safety_tolerance.description: Tolerance level for input and output moderation. Between 0 and 6, where 0 is most strict and 6 is least strict.

seed.description: Optional seed for reproducibility. Using the same seed with the same parameters will generate similar results.

webhook_url.description: URL to receive webhook notifications when the task completes. Must be between 1 and 2083 characters.

webhook_secret.description: Optional secret for webhook signature verification.

prompt.description: Required prompt. The gateway enforces a 10000-byte UTF-8 limit.
Required prompt. The gateway enforces a 5000-byte UTF-8 limit.

SeedreamSubmitRequest.description: Seedream 4.0 and 4.5 share this request schema. input image count + effective batch_size must be at most 15.

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation.
prompt.example: A beautiful sunset over the ocean

image_urls.description: Array of input image URLs for image-to-image generation (max 8).

width.description: Output width in pixels (must be used with height).

height.description: Output height in pixels (must be used with width).

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation.
prompt.example: A beautiful sunset over the ocean

image_urls.description: Array of input image URLs for image-to-image generation (max 8).

width.description: Output width in pixels (must be used with height).

height.description: Output height in pixels (must be used with width).

prompt_upsampling.description: Enable prompt upsampling for enhanced generation.

guidance.description: Guidance scale. Higher values improve prompt adherence at cost of realism.

steps.description: Number of generation steps. Higher values produce more detailed images.

human_image.description: Human image (Base64 or accessible URL). jpg/jpeg/png, up to 10MB, width/height at least 300px.

cloth_image.description: Garment image. Supports top/bottom/one-piece. Base64 or accessible URL. jpg/jpeg/png, up to 10MB, width/height at least 300px. v1-5 supports stitched top+bottom.

model_name.description: Model version. v1 = single garment; v1-5 supports stitched top+bottom.

prompt.description: Optional prompt for compatibility.
Text prompt for video generation (max 800 characters).
prompt.example: A majestic dragon flying through clouds at sunset

type.description: Generation type: text-to-video (pure text) or image-to-video (requires 1 image).

image_urls.description: Input image URL array for image-to-video mode. Exactly 1 image required for image-to-video.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio (only valid for text-to-video mode). In image-to-video mode, aspect ratio is determined by input image.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to describe content to avoid (max 500 characters).

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Whether to enable LLM prompt expansion for enhanced generation.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Same seed with same parameters produces similar results.

prompt.description: Text prompt for video generation (1-5000 characters). Supports both Chinese and English.
prompt.example: A cinematic aerial shot of a futuristic city at twilight with flying cars navigating between towering skyscrapers.

type.description: Generation type: text-to-video (pure text) or image-to-video (requires image_urls).

image_urls.description: Array of input image URLs for image-to-video mode. Required for image-to-video, omit for text-to-video.

resolution.description: Only 720p is offered (97 credits/s). 1080p is no longer available.

video_url.description: Source video URL. Accepted types: video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/x-matroska. Max file size: 10MB.

image_url.description: Reference image URL. Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp. Max file size: 10MB. If aspect ratio doesn't match, image is resized and center-cropped.

resolution.description: Output video resolution. 480p = 35 credits/s, 580p = 52 credits/s, 720p = 70 credits/s.

retry_after.description: Retry delay in seconds. Present for rate-limit errors.

task_id.description: Wizzx task ID used for status polling.

action.description: Music action. Returned only by POST /api/v1/music/{action}.

credits_deducted.description: Credits reserved when the task is accepted.

provider_task_id.description: Diagnostic field returned only when debug=1.

provider_key.description: Diagnostic field returned only when debug=1.

status.description: DISPATCHING is internal and is returned to clients as PROCESSING.

result_urls.description: Result media URLs. For music tasks: every track audio_url, then download files, then the music video. Text and analysis results (lyrics, BPM, MIDI, persona, model) have no URL; read result instead.

credits_deducted.description: Reserved or finally settled credits for this task.

params.description: Request parameters that select this pricing tier.

prompt.description: Required prompt. The gateway enforces a 20000-byte UTF-8 limit.
Required prompt. The gateway enforces a 20000-byte UTF-8 limit.
Required prompt. The gateway enforces a 32000-byte UTF-8 limit.

GPTImage25SubmitRequest.description: Omit image_urls for text-to-image; provide 1-16 images for image-to-image editing. One image per request. version, aspect_ratio, and reference images do not change the price.

prompt.description: Required prompt. The gateway enforces a 20000-byte UTF-8 limit.

version.description: flare is faster; sunburst gives finer edits for product, ad, and multi-turn editing. Same price.

items.description: HTTP(S) URL or base64 data URI. JPEG, PNG, or WebP only.

QwenImage2SubmitRequest.description: Shared by qwen-image-2.0 and qwen-image-2.0-pro. Omit image_urls for text-to-image or provide 1-3 public URLs for image-to-image. One image per request; 1K and 2K cost the same.

prompt.description: Required prompt, at most 800 Unicode characters.

resolution.description: Case-insensitive. Does not change the price.

KlingV3SubmitRequest.description: text-to-video must omit image_urls; image-to-video takes 1 image (first frame) or 2 images (first and last frame). Billed per second by resolution and generate_audio.

prompt.description: Required prompt, at most 2500 Unicode characters.

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to 16:9. In image-to-video the first frame's ratio may take precedence.

generate_audio.description: Generate native audio. Audio selects a higher per-second rate.

KlingV3OmniSubmitRequest.description: text-to-video must omit image_urls; image-to-video takes 1-2 frames (first, last); reference-to-video takes 1-7 reference images that the prompt can cite as <<<image_1>>> ... <<<image_N>>>. Reference images are not billed.

prompt.description: Required prompt, at most 2500 Unicode characters.

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to 16:9. In image-to-video the first frame's ratio may take precedence.

generate_audio.description: Generate native audio. Audio selects a higher per-second rate.

Seedance20MiniSubmitRequest.description: text-to-video must omit image_urls; image-to-video takes 1 image (first frame) or 2 images (first and last frame). Billed per second by resolution; audio is included at no extra charge.

prompt.description: Required prompt, at most 4000 Unicode characters.

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to 16:9 for text-to-video and adaptive for image-to-video. auto is an alias of adaptive.

PixverseV6SubmitRequest.description: text-to-video must omit image_urls. image-to-video takes 1 image, or 2 images for a first/last-frame transition (duration 5 or 8 only), and must omit aspect_ratio because the output follows the input image. reference-to-video fuses 1-7 reference images. Billed per second by resolution and generate_audio.

prompt.description: Required prompt, at most 5000 Unicode characters.

aspect_ratio.description: Text-to-video and reference-to-video only; defaults to 16:9. Rejected for image-to-video.

generate_audio.description: Add an audio track. Audio selects a higher per-second rate.

GrokImagineVideo15SubmitRequest.description: type is optional and inferred from image_urls: none means text-to-video, 1-7 images means image-to-video. With reference images the output follows the reference image's aspect ratio. Billed per second by resolution; reference images are not billed.

GeminiOmniFlashSubmitRequest.description: type is optional and inferred from image_urls: none means text-to-video, 1 image means image-to-video (first frame), 3 images means reference-to-video. reference-to-video accepts 1 or 3 images (2 is rejected). Billed per request by resolution and duration; reference images are not billed.

Wan26FlashSubmitRequest.description: Image-to-video only, silent output. Provide exactly one first-frame image; the output aspect ratio follows the image. Billed per second by resolution.

prompt.description: Optional prompt, at most 1500 characters.

prompt_extend.description: Smart prompt rewriting. Enabled unless set to false.

shot_type.description: Single-shot or multi-shot narrative. Requires prompt_extend not to be false.

SunoSubmitRequest.description: Legacy entry for Suno music generation; identical to POST /api/v1/music/generate. Inspiration mode (custom=false) takes a song description in prompt. Custom mode (custom=true) takes lyrics in prompt plus optional title, style, negative_tags, auto_lyrics, persona_task_id, max_mode, and duration. One request usually returns 2 tracks. Billed per request; max_mode doubles the price.

prompt.description: Inspiration mode: required song description, at most 3000 characters. Custom mode: lyrics, at most 5000 characters; required unless instrumental is true.

instrumental.description: No vocals. A custom-mode instrumental needs prompt or style.

version.description: Case-insensitive. All versions cost the same. Cannot be combined with custom_model_task_id.

custom_model_task_id.description: task_id of your SUCCEEDED create-model task. Replaces version; cannot be combined with version or persona_task_id.

persona_task_id.description: task_id of your SUCCEEDED persona task. Custom mode only.

negative_tags.description: Custom mode only. Styles to avoid.

style_weight.description: How strongly to follow style, 0-1. Custom mode only on actions other than generate.

audio_weight.description: How closely to follow the source audio, 0-1. Custom mode only on actions other than generate.

vocal_gender.description: Case-insensitive; m and f are accepted. Cannot be combined with instrumental=true.

max_mode.description: Custom mode only. Higher quality at double the price.

duration.description: Custom mode only. Target length in seconds; actual length may differ. Does not change the price.

Seedream5ProSubmitRequest.description: Omit image_urls for text-to-image or provide exactly one reference image for editing. One image per request. Billed per image by resolution; 1.5K costs the same as 1K. aspect_ratio, output_format, and the reference image do not change the price.

prompt.description: Required prompt, at most 4000 Unicode characters.

items.description: HTTP(S) URL or base64 data URI. JPEG, PNG, or WebP only.

MusicActionRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/v1/music/{action}. Each action accepts only its own fields, listed per action in x-wizzx-music-actions; sending a field the action does not accept returns 422. Earlier tasks are referenced by Wizzx task_id only and must be your own SUCCEEDED suno tasks.

prompt.description: Lyrics in custom mode (at most 5000 characters). A description (at most 3000 characters) for generate inspiration mode, the lyrics topic, and the sounds description.

gpt_description.description: Song description for inspiration mode (custom=false) on actions other than generate.

custom.description: Custom (lyrics) mode. generate defaults to false; extend defaults to true; upload-cover requires it; cover, add-vocals, add-instrumental, add-stem, mashup, and sample infer it when omitted (prompt, style, or title means true; gpt_description means false).

instrumental.description: No vocals. Cannot be combined with vocal_gender.

version.description: Case-insensitive. All versions cost the same. Cannot be combined with custom_model_task_id.

custom_model_task_id.description: task_id of your SUCCEEDED create-model task. Replaces version; cannot be combined with version or persona_task_id.

persona_task_id.description: task_id of your SUCCEEDED persona task. Custom mode only.

title.description: Custom mode only on actions with a mode switch.

style.description: Style tags. Custom mode only on actions with a mode switch. Required by upsample-tags.

negative_tags.description: Styles to avoid. Custom mode only on actions with a mode switch.

style_weight.description: How strongly to follow style, 0-1. Custom mode only on actions other than generate.

audio_weight.description: How closely to follow the source audio, 0-1. Custom mode only on actions other than generate.

vocal_gender.description: Case-insensitive; m and f are accepted. Cannot be combined with instrumental=true.

max_mode.description: Higher quality at double the price. Requires custom mode on actions with a mode switch.

duration.description: Target length in seconds; actual length may differ. Custom mode only on actions with a mode switch. Does not change the price.

task_id.description: Source task: one of your SUCCEEDED suno tasks that produced tracks.

audio_indexes.description: mashup: track index for each task_ids entry.

audio_url.description: Publicly reachable HTTP(S) audio URL, at most 2048 characters.

items.description: Publicly reachable HTTP(S) audio URL, at most 2048 characters.

audio_urls.description: inspo: 1-4 reference audio URLs. create-model: 6-24 training audio URLs.

continue_at.description: Seconds into the source audio where the continuation starts. For extend it must be less than the source track duration.

end_s.description: Section end in seconds. Greater than start_s and not beyond the source track duration.

fade_duration.description: Fade length in seconds; not longer than the source track.

infill_lyrics.description: replace-section: lyrics for the replaced section.

key.description: Sharp notation; append m for minor.

index.description: 1-based position. Pass it as audio_index (or an audio_indexes entry) to reference this track.

audio_url.description: May be absent, for example on upload tasks.

MusicTaskResult.description: Structured output of a finished music task. Present only when the task produced structured output; which fields are set depends on the action. Tasks finished before 2026-10-15 have no result.

tracks.description: Audio tracks in order. Set by generate, extend, cover, stems, and every other track-producing action.

persona_id.description: persona action. Informational; reference the persona with this task's task_id as persona_task_id.

model_id.description: create-model action. Informational; reference the model with this task's task_id as custom_model_task_id.

tags.name: Legacy models
tags.description: Compatibility-only models hidden from /pricing. Do not select these automatically.
